title: IELTS Writing: Foundations
description: Task 2 opinion, discussion, problem–solution and advantages/disadvantages essays and a Task 1 line graph and bar chart, each with a band-7 model answer, useful phrases and practice on thesis statements, linking, paraphrasing and common errors. Written for Bo-ok.

units.title: Should University Be Free?
units.goal: Task 2 opinion essay: take a clear position and keep it from the first paragraph to the last.

blocks.text: The task

Some people think that university education should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
What the task asks

"To what extent do you agree or disagree?" asks for YOUR opinion. You may agree completely, disagree completely or agree in part, but the examiner must know your position from the introduction, and every body paragraph should support it. An essay that lists both sides without deciding is answering a different question. Plan four or five paragraphs: introduction with your position, two or three body paragraphs, each with one main idea, and a short conclusion that repeats your position in new words.
A band-7 model answer

It is often argued that university should be free for every student, with the cost paid by the state through taxation. While I accept that money should never prevent a talented young person from studying, I do not believe that higher education should be completely free for all, since this would place a heavy burden on public finances and is not the fairest way to help those in need.

There are strong reasons to reduce the cost of university. A degree can open the door to better-paid and more secure work, so high fees risk turning higher education into a privilege of the wealthy. Students from low-income families may be put off by the prospect of years of debt, even when they have the ability to succeed. In addition, society as a whole benefits from a well-educated workforce, as doctors, engineers and teachers provide services that everyone relies on.

However, making university free for everyone would be extremely expensive, and the money would come from taxes paid by all citizens, including those who never attend university. Furthermore, a free system tends to benefit middle-class families most, because their children are more likely to go to university in the first place. In countries with limited budgets, this money might be better spent on primary schools or vocational training, which reach a far wider part of the population.

In my view, a more balanced approach would be to keep moderate fees but offer generous grants to students from poorer backgrounds, together with loans that are repaid only when graduates earn above a certain income. This would protect access to university without asking the whole of society to pay for everyone's degree.

In conclusion, although nobody should be excluded from university because of cost, I disagree that it should be free for everyone. Targeted financial support is a fairer and more sustainable solution.
Useful phrases

items.example: It is often argued that homework does more harm than good.

items.en: While I accept that…, I do not believe that…
items.tr: … olduğunu kabul etsem de … olduğuna inanmıyorum.
items.ar: مع أنني أُسلّم بأنّ…، لا أعتقد أنّ…
items.example: While I accept that cars are convenient, I do not believe that cities need more roads.
An ageing population places a heavy burden on the health service.
Many young people are put off by the high cost of housing.
Tax cuts tend to benefit people who already earn a lot.

items.en: a more balanced approach would be to…
items.example: A more balanced approach would be to limit screen time, not ban it.
In conclusion, although tourism brings money, I believe it must be controlled.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Which is the best thesis statement for this task?
options: University education is a very important topic nowadays.
In this essay, I will talk about free university education.
Although cost should not stop able students, I disagree that university should be free for everyone, because targeted support is fairer.
Free university has good sides and bad sides.

why.tr: İyi bir tez cümlesi soruyu cevaplar ve konumunu gösterir. A ve B konuyu tekrar eder ama görüş yok; D iki tarafı söyler ama karar vermez. C hem görüşü (disagree) hem de nedenini veriyor.
why.ar: جملة الأطروحة الجيدة تجيب عن السؤال وتوضح موقفك. A وB تكرران الموضوع بلا رأي، وD تذكر الجانبين بلا قرار. أما C فتعطي الموقف (disagree) والسبب.
why.en: A thesis answers the question and states a position. Only C gives a clear opinion and a reason.

blocks.example: Although tourism creates jobs, I believe it should be limited, because it damages historic centres.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best paraphrase of “university education should be free for everyone”?
options: everyone should go to university
students should not have to pay tuition fees, whatever their background
universities should be cheaper than schools
the government should build more universities

why.tr: Paraphrase anlamı korur, kelimeleri değiştirir. "free" → "not have to pay tuition fees", "for everyone" → "whatever their background". A anlamı değiştiriyor: herkesin gitmesi gerektiğini söylüyor, ücretsiz olmayı değil.
why.ar: إعادة الصياغة تحافظ على المعنى بكلمات أخرى: free ← not have to pay tuition fees، وfor everyone ← whatever their background. أما A فتغيّر المعنى: تتحدث عن ذهاب الجميع لا عن المجانية.
why.en: A paraphrase keeps the meaning: free → "not have to pay tuition fees"; for everyone → "whatever their background". A changes the meaning.

blocks.example: Some people believe that students should not have to pay tuition fees, whatever their background.

blocks.prompt: A degree can lead to better jobs. ___, society benefits from well-educated workers.
options: However
In addition
As a result
Otherwise

why.tr: İkinci cümle aynı yönde yeni bir neden ekliyor (üniversitenin faydaları). Ekleme için "In addition", "Moreover", "Furthermore" kullanılır. "However" zıtlık, "As a result" sonuç bildirir.
why.ar: الجملة الثانية تضيف سببًا آخر في الاتجاه نفسه، فنستخدم In addition أو Moreover. أما However فللتضاد، وAs a result للنتيجة.
why.en: The second sentence adds another reason in the same direction, so we need an adding word.

blocks.example: The plan saves money. In addition, it reduces pollution.

blocks.prompt: Free education sounds fair. ___, it often benefits wealthier families most.
options: Therefore
However
For example
Similarly

why.tr: İlk cümle olumlu, ikincisi beklenmedik bir sorun söylüyor: zıtlık var. Zıtlık için "However" ya da "Nevertheless". "Therefore" sonuç bildirir, burada mantıksız.
why.ar: الجملة الأولى إيجابية والثانية تذكر مشكلة غير متوقعة، أي يوجد تضاد، فنستخدم However. أما Therefore فتعني "لذلك" ولا تناسب.
why.en: The second idea contrasts with the first, so we need a contrast word: However.

blocks.example: The hotel looked lovely online. However, the rooms were small and noisy.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Students from low-income families may be put off from the prospect of debt.”

why.tr: Doğru kalıp "be put off BY something": bir şey yüzünden hevesi kaçmak. "from" yanlış edat.
why.ar: التركيب الصحيح be put off BY something، أي يُعزف عن الشيء بسببه. حرف الجر from خطأ.
why.en: The phrase is "be put off by something".

blocks.example: Many tourists are put off by the long queues.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Society as a whole benefit from a well-educated workforce.”

why.tr: Özne "society" tekil (he/she/it gibi), geniş zamanda fiile -s gelir: "society benefits". "as a whole" özneyi çoğul yapmaz.
why.ar: الفاعل society مفرد، فيأخذ الفعل في المضارع البسيط -s: society benefits. عبارة as a whole لا تجعله جمعًا.
why.en: "Society" is singular, so the present simple verb needs -s: benefits.

blocks.example: The community as a whole benefits from the new park.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Doctors and teachers provide services that everyone rely on.”

why.tr: "everyone" anlamca çok kişi demek ama dilbilgisi olarak tekildir: "everyone relies", "everybody knows".
why.ar: كلمة everyone تدل على الجميع لكنها مفردة نحويًا: everyone relies وeverybody knows.
why.en: "Everyone" takes a singular verb: everyone relies.

blocks.example: Everyone relies on clean water.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best topic sentence for the paragraph against free university?
options: University is expensive.
However, making university free for everyone would be extremely expensive for the state.
My cousin paid a lot for his degree.
There are many universities in my country.

why.tr: Konu cümlesi paragrafın ana fikrini söyler ve tezine bağlanır. B hem zıtlığı (However) hem de ana fikri (devlete çok pahalı) veriyor. C bir örnek; konu cümlesi değil, destek cümlesi olabilir.
why.ar: الجملة المفتاحية تذكر فكرة الفقرة الرئيسية وترتبط بالأطروحة. B تعطي التضاد (However) والفكرة (تكلفة عالية على الدولة). C مجرد مثال يصلح للدعم لا للبداية.
why.en: A topic sentence states the paragraph's main idea and links to the thesis. C is only an example.

blocks.example: However, building more roads would not solve the problem of traffic.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence has the right style for an IELTS essay?
options: Lots of people reckon uni should be free.
Many people believe that university should be free.
Everybody knows uni's gotta be free, right?
I think, like, university should be free.

why.tr: IELTS yazısı resmî olmalı: "lots of", "reckon", "uni", kısaltmalar ("uni's") ve konuşma dili ("like", "right?") uygun değil. B nötr ve akademik.
why.ar: يجب أن تكون كتابة الآيلتس رسمية: lots of وreckon وuni والاختصارات ولغة الكلام (like وright?) غير مناسبة. أما B فمحايدة وأكاديمية.
why.en: Essays need a formal style: avoid "lots of", "reckon", "uni", contractions and spoken fillers.

blocks.example: Many people believe that public transport should be free.

units.title: When Should Children Start a Second Language?
units.goal: Task 2 discussion essay: present both views fairly, then give your own opinion.

blocks.text: The task

Some people believe that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school, while others think they should begin at secondary school. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
What the task asks

A discussion essay has three jobs: explain the first view, explain the second view, and say what you think. Give each view its own body paragraph and present it fairly — use phrases such as "Those who … argue that…" so it is clear these are other people's ideas. Your own opinion should appear in the introduction and the conclusion; many writers also give it a short paragraph of its own. If you forget your opinion, you have answered only part of the question.
A band-7 model answer

Opinions differ on when children should begin learning a foreign language. Some argue that it should be introduced in the first years of primary school, whereas others believe it is better to wait until secondary school. This essay will consider both positions before explaining why I favour an early start.

Those who prefer a later start make several reasonable points. Young children are still developing their reading and writing skills in their first language, and adding a second one too early may, in their view, overload them. Moreover, primary schools often lack teachers who speak the foreign language well, so lessons may be of poor quality. Older learners, by contrast, can understand grammar rules, use dictionaries independently and see clearly why the language is useful, which may allow them to make faster progress.

On the other hand, supporters of early learning argue that young children have important advantages. They tend to be less anxious about making mistakes and more willing to imitate new sounds, which can lead to better pronunciation. Starting early also means that pupils have many more years of contact with the language by the time they leave school. Perhaps most importantly, learning another language at a young age can make children curious about other cultures while their attitudes are still forming.

In my opinion, the benefits of an early start outweigh the drawbacks, provided that lessons are suited to young learners. At primary level, the focus should be on songs, games and speaking rather than formal grammar, and schools need properly trained teachers. If these conditions are met, children are likely to develop both confidence and a lasting interest in the language.

To sum up, while older students may learn certain aspects of a language more efficiently, I believe that introducing foreign languages at primary school gives children a valuable head start, as long as the teaching is appropriate for their age.
Useful phrases

items.example: Opinions differ on whether homework is useful.
Some prefer the city, whereas others prefer the countryside.
Those who support the ban argue that it will save lives.
Summers are hot. By contrast, winters are very cold.
The benefits of the new system outweigh the drawbacks.
You can borrow the car, provided that you return it by six.
Reading at home gives children a head start at school.
To sum up, both views have some merit.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: What must a “discuss both views and give your opinion” essay contain?
options: Only your own opinion.
Both views, and your own opinion.
Only the view you disagree with.
A list of advantages and disadvantages of foreign languages.

why.tr: Talimatta iki görev var: "Discuss both views" VE "give your own opinion". Birini atlarsan Task Response puanın düşer. D farklı bir soru tipi (advantages/disadvantages).
why.ar: في التعليمات مهمتان: ناقش الرأيين وقدّم رأيك. إن أهملت إحداهما تنخفض درجة Task Response. أما D فنوع آخر من الأسئلة.
why.en: The instructions ask for two things: discuss both views AND give your opinion.

blocks.example: The essay discusses both views and then gives the writer's opinion.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best final sentence for the introduction?
options: I think children should learn languages.
Languages are important in today's world.
This essay will consider both positions before explaining why I favour an early start.
There are many languages in the world.

why.tr: C iki görüşü ele alacağını ve kendi tarafını (early start) söylüyor: okuyucu planı ve konumu görür. A görüş veriyor ama ne zaman başlanacağını söylemiyor; B ve D soruyla ilgisiz genellemeler.
why.ar: C تبيّن أن المقال سيناقش الرأيين وتوضح موقف الكاتب (البداية المبكرة). A رأي غير محدد، وB وD تعميمات لا تجيب عن السؤال.
why.en: C shows the plan (both views) and the writer's position (an early start).

blocks.example: This essay will look at both sides before explaining why I support the plan.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best paraphrase of “start learning a foreign language at primary school”?
options: learn their first language at school
be introduced to a second language in their first years of schooling
study abroad at a young age
go to a language school after class

why.tr: "foreign language" → "a second language", "start" → "be introduced to", "primary school" → "first years of schooling". A ana dil diyor, yanlış anlam; C ve D farklı fikirler.
why.ar: foreign language ← a second language، وstart ← be introduced to، وprimary school ← first years of schooling. A تتحدث عن اللغة الأم، وC وD أفكار مختلفة.
why.en: Each part is replaced with a synonym but the meaning stays the same.

blocks.example: Many children are introduced to a second language in their first years of schooling.

blocks.prompt: Older learners can understand grammar rules. Young children, ___, are less afraid of making mistakes.
options: by contrast
as a result
for instance
in addition

why.tr: İki grup karşılaştırılıyor: büyükler bir konuda iyi, küçükler başka bir konuda. Karşılaştırma ve zıtlık için "by contrast"; cümle ortasında virgüller arasında gelebilir.
why.ar: نقارن بين فئتين: الكبار جيدون في أمر والصغار في أمر آخر. للمقارنة والتضاد نستخدم by contrast، ويمكن وضعها بين فاصلتين وسط الجملة.
why.en: Two groups are being contrasted, so "by contrast" fits.

blocks.example: Cities are crowded. Villages, by contrast, are quiet.

blocks.prompt: Early lessons are useful, ___ they are suited to young learners.
options: provided that
although
because of
despite

why.tr: İkinci kısım bir şart: dersler küçüklere uygunsa faydalı. Şart için "provided that" (= only if). "because of" ve "despite" ardından isim alır, cümle değil.
why.ar: الجزء الثاني شرط: الدروس مفيدة إذا كانت مناسبة للصغار، فنستخدم provided that بمعنى "بشرط أن". أما because of وdespite فيأتي بعدهما اسم لا جملة.
why.en: The second part is a condition (only if), so "provided that" fits.

blocks.example: You can join the class, provided that you bring your own laptop.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Some people argue that a foreign language should be introduce at primary school.”

why.tr: "should be + V3" edilgen yapıdır: dil (biri tarafından) tanıtılır. "be" sonrası fiil üçüncü hâlde olmalı: "be introduced".
why.ar: التركيب should be + التصريف الثالث مبني للمجهول: be introduced. بعد be يأتي الفعل في التصريف الثالث.
why.en: After "should be" we need the past participle: introduced.

blocks.example: The new rules will be introduced next month.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “The benefits of an early start outweighs the drawbacks.”

why.tr: Özne "the benefits" (çoğul), "start" değil. Çoğul özneyle geniş zamanda -s yok: "the benefits outweigh". Fiile en yakın isme değil, gerçek özneye bak.
why.ar: الفاعل هو the benefits (جمع) وليس start، فلا نضيف -s: the benefits outweigh. انظر إلى الفاعل الحقيقي لا إلى أقرب اسم.
why.en: The subject is "the benefits" (plural), not "start", so no -s: outweigh.

blocks.example: The advantages of the plan outweigh the costs.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Young children are less anxious about make mistakes.”

why.tr: Edattan (about, of, in, without…) sonra fiil -ing alır: "anxious about making mistakes".
why.ar: بعد حروف الجر مثل about وof وin يأتي الفعل بصيغة -ing: anxious about making mistakes.
why.en: After a preposition (about), a verb takes the -ing form: making.

blocks.example: She is worried about losing her job.

blocks.prompt: In a discussion essay, where should your own opinion appear?
options: Only in the last sentence.
In the introduction and the conclusion, and it can be developed in a body paragraph.
Nowhere — a discussion must be neutral.
Only in the first body paragraph.

why.tr: Soru açıkça "give your own opinion" diyor, yani tarafsız kalamazsın. Görüşün girişte belirtilmeli, sonuçta tekrar edilmeli; isteğe bağlı olarak ayrı bir paragrafta açıklanabilir.
why.ar: السؤال يطلب صراحة رأيك، فلا يمكن أن تبقى محايدًا. اذكر رأيك في المقدمة وأعده في الخاتمة، ويمكنك شرحه في فقرة مستقلة.
why.en: The task asks for your opinion, so state it in the introduction and conclusion; you may develop it in a body paragraph.

blocks.example: In my opinion, the benefits of an early start outweigh the drawbacks.

units.title: Cities Stuck in Traffic
units.goal: Task 2 problem–solution essay: match each cause with a realistic solution.

blocks.text: The task
In many cities, traffic congestion is getting worse. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to solve it? Write at least 250 words.
What the task asks

There are two questions here, and you must answer both: causes AND solutions. A clear plan is one body paragraph for causes and one for solutions. The strongest essays link them: if one cause is poor public transport, one solution should improve it. Develop each idea — say what the cause is, why it leads to the problem, and, for solutions, how they would work. Two or three well-explained ideas are better than six listed ones.
A band-7 model answer

Traffic congestion has become a daily frustration in many cities around the world, wasting time and adding to air pollution. This essay will examine the main causes of the problem and suggest measures that governments and individuals could take to tackle it.

The most obvious cause is the growing number of private cars. As incomes rise, more families can afford a car, and many see it as more comfortable and convenient than public transport. A second cause is the way cities have developed. When homes are built far from workplaces, schools and shops, people have little choice but to drive long distances every day. Finally, in many places public transport is unreliable, overcrowded or simply not available, which pushes even more people onto the roads.

Several measures could help to reduce congestion. Firstly, governments should invest in fast, frequent and affordable public transport, such as metro lines and dedicated bus lanes, so that leaving the car at home becomes a realistic option. Secondly, some cities have introduced a charge for driving into the centre at busy times, which encourages drivers to travel at other times or by other means; the money raised can then fund further improvements. In the longer term, planners could design mixed neighbourhoods where housing, jobs and services are close together, reducing the need to travel at all. Employers can also play a part by allowing flexible hours or working from home on some days, which spreads journeys more evenly through the day.

In conclusion, traffic congestion is caused mainly by rising car ownership, poorly planned urban growth and inadequate public transport. A combination of better public transport, congestion charges and smarter urban planning, supported by flexible working, offers the most promising way to keep cities moving.
Useful phrases

items.example: For many commuters, delays are a daily frustration.

items.tr: bir sorunla mücadele etmek, ele almak
items.example: The government has promised to tackle the problem of housing.

items.ar: لا يكون أمامه خيار سوى أن
items.example: Without a bus service, villagers have little choice but to drive.
The city plans to invest in cycle paths.
A dedicated bus lane keeps buses moving at rush hour.
London introduced a congestion charge in 2003.
Schools can play a part in reducing waste.
Prevention is the most promising way to cut health costs.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: What must this essay answer?
options: Only the causes of traffic congestion.
Only the solutions to traffic congestion.
Both the causes and the solutions.
Whether you agree that traffic is getting worse.

why.tr: Soruda iki ayrı soru var: "What are the causes..." VE "what measures could be taken...". Biri eksik olursa görev tamamlanmamış sayılır. D tuzak: sorun zaten verilmiş, katılıp katılmadığın sorulmuyor.
why.ar: في المهمة سؤالان: ما الأسباب، وما الحلول. إن أجبت عن واحد فقط فالمهمة ناقصة. D فخّ: المشكلة معطاة ولا يُسأل عن موافقتك.
why.en: The prompt has two questions: causes and measures. Answer both.

blocks.example: The essay explains the causes of the problem and then suggests solutions.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best thesis statement?
options: Traffic is a big problem.
This essay will examine the main causes of the problem and suggest measures to tackle it.
Cars are bad and people should walk.
I agree that traffic is getting worse.

why.tr: Problem–çözüm yazısında tez, iki görevi de (nedenler + çözümler) ele alacağını söyler. A çok genel; C tek taraflı bir görüş; D "agree" sorusu sorulmadığı için yanlış.
why.ar: في مقال المشكلة والحل تذكر الأطروحة أنك ستتناول الأسباب والحلول معًا. A عامة جدًا، وC رأي أحادي، وD خطأ لأن السؤال لا يطلب الموافقة.
why.en: The thesis should promise both parts: causes and measures.

blocks.example: This essay will examine why the problem has grown and suggest ways to solve it.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best paraphrase of “traffic congestion is getting worse”?
options: cars are becoming more expensive
roads are becoming increasingly crowded with vehicles
public transport is getting worse
people are driving more carefully

why.tr: "congestion" = yolların araçla dolması; "getting worse" = "becoming increasingly...". B anlamı koruyor. C tuzak: "getting worse" aynı ama konu farklı.
why.ar: congestion تعني امتلاء الطرق بالسيارات، وgetting worse ← becoming increasingly. الخيار C فخّ: نفس الفعل لكن موضوع مختلف.
why.en: "Congestion" means crowded roads; "getting worse" becomes "increasingly crowded".

blocks.example: In many cities, roads are becoming increasingly crowded with vehicles.

blocks.prompt: Public transport is often unreliable, ___ many people prefer to drive.
options: so
although
unless
whereas

why.tr: İlk kısım neden, ikincisi sonuç: toplu taşıma güvenilmez OLDUĞU İÇİN insanlar araba kullanıyor. Sonuç için "so". "although" zıtlık, "unless" şart bildirir.
why.ar: الجزء الأول سبب والثاني نتيجة، فنستخدم so. أما although فللتضاد وunless للشرط.
why.en: Cause then result: "so".

blocks.example: The trains were cancelled, so we took a taxi.

blocks.prompt: ___ incomes rise, more families can afford a car.
options: As
Despite
However
Unless

why.tr: "As" burada "-dikçe" anlamında: gelir arttıkça daha çok aile araba alabiliyor. "Despite" ardından isim alır; "However" iki cümleyi bu şekilde bağlamaz.
why.ar: As هنا بمعنى "كلما" أو "مع": مع ارتفاع الدخل تستطيع أسر أكثر شراء سيارة. Despite يأتي بعدها اسم، وHowever لا تربط الجملتين بهذا الشكل.
why.en: "As" means "while/because" something increases: as incomes rise…

blocks.example: As the city grew, the old market became too small.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Governments should invest on fast and affordable public transport.”

why.tr: Doğru kalıp "invest IN something". Türkçedeki "-e yatırım" ve Arapçadaki "في" gibi, İngilizcede de "in".
why.ar: التركيب الصحيح invest IN something، تمامًا مثل "يستثمر في".
why.en: The verb is "invest in".

blocks.example: The company invested in new technology.

blocks.prompt: One word is missing. Write it. “People have little choice but drive long distances every day.”

why.tr: Kalıp: "have little choice but TO + fiil". "but" burada "-den başka" demek ve ardından "to" gelir.
why.ar: التركيب: have little choice but TO + فعل، وbut هنا بمعنى "سوى".
why.en: The pattern is "have little choice but to + verb".

blocks.example: We had little choice but to wait for the next train.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “There are too much cars in the city centre.”

why.tr: "car" sayılabilir bir isim; sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle "many", sayılamayanlarla "much" kullanılır: "too many cars", "too much traffic".
why.ar: car اسم معدود، ومع الجمع المعدود نستخدم many، ومع غير المعدود much: too many cars، too much traffic.
why.en: "Cars" is countable, so "too many"; "too much" is for uncountable nouns like traffic.

blocks.example: There are too many cars and too much noise in the centre.

blocks.prompt: Which solution is the best developed?
options: Governments should do something about it.
Public transport is good.
Governments should invest in frequent, affordable buses so that leaving the car at home becomes a realistic option.
Cars are bad, so people should not use them.

why.tr: İyi bir çözüm cümlesi kim (governments), ne (frequent, affordable buses) ve nasıl işe yarayacağını (so that ...) söyler. A ve B çok belirsiz; D gerçekçi değil ve açıklama yok.
why.ar: الحل الجيد يذكر من (الحكومات) وماذا (حافلات متكررة وبأسعار معقولة) وكيف يعمل (so that...). A وB غامضتان، وD غير واقعية وبلا شرح.
why.en: A developed solution says who, what and how it would work (so that…).

blocks.example: Schools could offer free breakfast so that no child starts the day hungry.

units.title: Describing a Line Graph
units.goal: Task 1 line graph: write an overview, then support it with the key numbers.

blocks.text: The task

The graph shows the percentage of households in one country with home internet access, at least one smartphone and a landline telephone, from 2005 to 2025. Summarise the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. (The figures are practice data written for Bo-ok.)
The data
What the task asks

Task 1 is a report, not an essay: do not give your opinion or guess the reasons. Start by paraphrasing what the graph shows. Then write an overview — two sentences about the main trends, with no detailed numbers. This is the paragraph examiners look for first. In the body paragraphs, group the lines in a sensible way (here: the one that fell, then the two that rose) and support each point with figures. Use past tenses because the period is over.
A band-7 model answer
The line graph illustrates the proportion of households in one country that had home internet access, a smartphone and a landline telephone between 2005 and 2025.
Overall, the two newer technologies grew rapidly, while landline ownership fell steadily throughout the period. By 2025, internet access and smartphones had reached almost all households.

In 2005, landlines were by far the most common, found in 88% of homes, compared with 40% for the internet and just 3% for smartphones. Over the following two decades, however, the share of homes with a landline declined continuously, dropping to 64% in 2015 and to only 30% by the end of the period.

Internet access, by contrast, rose steadily, overtaking landlines between 2010 and 2015 and reaching 92% in 2025. The most dramatic increase was in smartphone ownership, which nearly tripled from 22% in 2010 to 60% five years later and overtook landlines before 2020. It then continued to grow, though more slowly, and in 2025 it stood at 91%, almost the same level as internet access.
Useful phrases

items.example: The chart illustrates the proportion of students who walk to school.
Overall, sales rose during the year.
The bus was by far the most common way to travel.
Prices rose by 5%, compared with 2% the year before.
The number of letters sent declined continuously.
Online sales overtook shop sales in 2020.
The most dramatic increase was in electric cars.
Unemployment now stands at 6%.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: What should the overview contain?
options: Every number from the graph.
The main trends, without detailed numbers.
Your opinion about technology.
The reasons why landlines became less popular.

why.tr: Overview grafiğin genel resmidir: ne yükseldi, ne düştü, en büyük değişim ne. Ayrıntılı sayılar gövde paragraflarına aittir. Task 1'de görüş ve neden tahmini yazılmaz.
why.ar: الملخص العام يرسم الصورة الكبرى: ما الذي ارتفع وما الذي انخفض. الأرقام التفصيلية مكانها الفقرات التالية. ولا نكتب في المهمة الأولى رأيًا ولا أسبابًا متخيَّلة.
why.en: The overview gives the big picture; numbers go in the body. No opinions or reasons in Task 1.

blocks.example: Overall, the two newer technologies grew rapidly, while landlines declined.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best paraphrase of “the percentage of households”?
options: the number of people
the proportion of homes
the amount of houses
the percent of families members

why.tr: "percentage" → "proportion", "households" → "homes". A tuzak: "number" yüzde değil, sayıdır; "people" de hane değildir. C'de "amount" sayılabilir isimle kullanılmaz.
why.ar: percentage ← proportion، وhouseholds ← homes. الخيار A فخّ: number عدد لا نسبة، وpeople أفراد لا أُسر. وفي C لا تُستخدم amount مع اسم معدود.
why.en: percentage → proportion; households → homes. "Number" is not a percentage.

blocks.example: The proportion of homes with a garden fell slightly.

blocks.prompt: In 2025, smartphone ownership ___ at 91%. (Use a form of “stand”.)

why.tr: "stand at + sayı" bir değerin seviyesini verir. Dönem geçmişte olduğu için geçmiş zaman: stand → stood (düzensiz fiil).
why.ar: stand at + رقم تعني "بلغ". الفترة في الماضي، فنستخدم الماضي: stand ← stood (فعل شاذ).
why.en: "Stand at" gives a level; the past form is "stood".

blocks.example: At the end of the year, the price stood at $40.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Landline ownership decreased from 88% at 30%.”

why.tr: Başlangıç ve bitiş değeri: "from X TO Y". "at" tek bir seviye için kullanılır (stood at 30%).
why.ar: للبداية والنهاية نقول from X TO Y. أما at فلمستوى واحد (stood at 30%).
why.en: Change is "from X to Y"; "at" is for a single level.

blocks.example: The temperature rose from 10 to 25 degrees.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “The number of homes with a smartphone rose dramatic.”

why.tr: "rose" bir fiil; fiili nitelemek için zarf gerekir: rose dramatically. Sıfat (dramatic) isimle gelir: a dramatic rise.
why.ar: rose فعل، ونصفه بظرف: rose dramatically. أما الصفة dramatic فتأتي مع الاسم: a dramatic rise.
why.en: A verb needs an adverb: rose dramatically (but: a dramatic rise).

blocks.example: Prices rose dramatically, and there was a dramatic fall in sales.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is accurate according to the data?
options: Internet access overtook landlines between 2010 and 2015.
Smartphones overtook home internet in 2020.
Landline ownership rose after 2015.
In 2010, more homes had a smartphone than a landline.

why.tr: 2010'da internet %58, sabit hat %80; 2015'te internet %74, sabit hat %64. Demek ki internet bu iki yıl arasında öne geçti. B: 2020'de akıllı telefon %83, internet %86. C: sabit hat hep düştü. D: 2010'da %22'ye %80.
why.ar: في 2010 كان الإنترنت 58% والهاتف الأرضي 80%، وفي 2015 صار الإنترنت 74% والأرضي 64%، أي أن الإنترنت تجاوزه بين العامين. B: في 2020 الهاتف الذكي 83% والإنترنت 86%. C: الأرضي انخفض دائمًا. D: 22% مقابل 80%.
why.en: Internet went from 58% (below 80%) in 2010 to 74% (above 64%) in 2015. The others contradict the data.

blocks.example: Online shopping overtook shop sales between 2018 and 2020.

blocks.prompt: Landline ownership fell. Internet access, ___, rose steadily.
options: by contrast
therefore
for example
moreover

why.tr: İki çizgi ters yöne gidiyor: biri düştü, biri yükseldi. Zıtlık için "by contrast". "therefore" sonuç, "moreover" ekleme bildirir.
why.ar: الخطّان في اتجاهين متعاكسين، فنستخدم by contrast للتضاد. أما therefore فللنتيجة وmoreover للإضافة.
why.en: The lines move in opposite directions: by contrast.

blocks.example: Car sales fell. Bicycle sales, by contrast, rose sharply.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best opening sentence?
options: The graph shows the percentage of households in one country with home internet access, at least one smartphone and a landline telephone.
The line graph illustrates the proportion of homes in one country that had internet access, a smartphone and a landline between 2005 and 2025.
Technology is very important in modern life.
The graph shows that smartphones are better than landlines.

why.tr: Giriş soruyu kendi kelimelerinle (paraphrase) yazmalı ve dönemi vermeli. A soruyu kelimesi kelimesine kopyalıyor; kopyalanan kelimeler sayılmaz. C genel bir yorum, D görüş bildiriyor.
why.ar: يجب أن تعيد المقدمة صياغة السؤال بكلماتك وتذكر الفترة. A تنسخ السؤال حرفيًا، والكلمات المنسوخة لا تُحتسب. C تعليق عام، وD رأي.
why.en: Paraphrase the prompt and give the period. A copies it word for word; D gives an opinion.

blocks.example: The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women who used public transport in 2020.

blocks.prompt: Between 2010 and 2015, smartphone ownership nearly ___ (became almost three times higher).

why.tr: %22'den %60'a çıkmak yaklaşık üç katına çıkmak demek: "triple" (veya İngiliz İngilizcesinde "treble"). İki katı: double.
why.ar: الارتفاع من 22% إلى 60% يعني أنها تضاعفت ثلاث مرات تقريبًا: triple (أو treble في الإنجليزية البريطانية). وللضعف نقول double.
why.en: From 22% to 60% is almost three times: tripled (or trebled). Two times is doubled.

blocks.example: The number of visitors nearly tripled in five years.

blocks.prompt: Which of these should NOT be in a Task 1 answer?
options: An overview of the main trends.
A comparison of the three lines.
Your opinion on why people stopped using landlines.
Figures that support the main points.

why.tr: Task 1 grafikte ne olduğunu anlatır; neden olduğunu tahmin etmez. Grafikte nedenler yoksa "because mobile phones are cheaper" gibi yorumlar puan kazandırmaz, hatta zarar verir.
why.ar: المهمة الأولى تصف ما في الرسم لا أسبابه. إن لم تكن الأسباب في الرسم فلا تكتب تخمينات مثل "لأن الهواتف المحمولة أرخص".
why.en: Task 1 reports what the data shows; reasons and opinions are not in the graph.

blocks.example: The graph shows a fall in landlines; it does not say why.

units.title: Working from Home: For and Against
units.goal: Task 2 advantages/disadvantages essay: weigh both sides and, when the question asks, say which side is stronger.

blocks.text: The task

In many countries, more and more people now work from home for at least part of the week instead of travelling to an office. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words.
What the task asks

There are two kinds of advantages/disadvantages question. "What are the advantages and disadvantages?" asks you to explain both sides; an opinion is not required. "Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?" asks you to compare them and decide which side is stronger, so it needs a clear answer in the introduction and the conclusion. Read the question carefully. A good plan is: introduction with your answer, one paragraph on the disadvantages, one on the advantages (put the side you think is stronger second, so the essay builds towards your view), and a short conclusion. Talk about the development in general; do not write only about your own job.
A band-7 model answer

Since fast internet connections became widely available, a growing number of employees have begun to work from home for some or all of the week. Although this trend has certain drawbacks, both for workers and for companies, I believe that its benefits are greater, provided that it is organised sensibly.

The most obvious disadvantage is isolation. Employees who rarely see their colleagues may feel lonely, and they miss the informal conversations in which ideas are often shared and problems solved. New staff in particular may find it harder to learn from more experienced colleagues when everyone is in a different place. In addition, the boundary between work and private life can become unclear: when the office is also the kitchen table, some people find it difficult to stop working in the evening.

On the other hand, the advantages are considerable. First, working from home removes the daily commute, which saves time and money and reduces traffic and pollution. An employee who once spent two hours a day on a crowded train can use that time to rest, exercise or be with family. Second, many people find that they can concentrate better at home, away from the noise and interruptions of an open-plan office. Companies benefit too, since they can rent smaller offices and recruit talented staff who live far from the city.

In conclusion, while working from home can lead to loneliness and longer working days, I would argue that these problems can largely be solved by combining home and office work. Because the savings in time, money and stress are so significant, the advantages of this development clearly outweigh its disadvantages.
Useful phrases

items.example: The most obvious disadvantage is the cost.
The main drawback of the plan is its high price.
The flat is small. In addition, it is noisy.
Cars are convenient. On the other hand, they cause pollution.
The new law has had a considerable effect.
Small shops will benefit from the new market.
You can borrow the car, provided that you return it today.
The benefits of exercise far outweigh the risks.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: The question asks: “Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” What must your essay do?
options: List the advantages only.
Describe both sides without giving a view.
Compare both sides and say clearly which is stronger.
Explain how to solve the problems of working from home.

why.tr: "Outweigh" sorusu bir karar istiyor: hangi taraf daha ağır basıyor? Bunu giriş ve sonuçta açıkça yaz. B, "What are the advantages and disadvantages?" sorusu için yeterli olurdu, bu soru için değil. D farklı bir soru tipi (problem–solution).
why.ar: سؤال outweigh يطلب حكمًا: أيّ الجانبين أقوى؟ اكتب ذلك بوضوح في المقدمة والخاتمة. الخيار B يكفي لسؤال "What are the advantages and disadvantages?" لا لهذا السؤال، وD نوع آخر (مشكلة وحل).
why.en: "Outweigh" needs a decision about which side is stronger, stated in the introduction and conclusion.

blocks.example: In my view, the advantages of online shopping outweigh the disadvantages.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best thesis statement for this essay?
options: Working from home has advantages and disadvantages.
Although working from home has some drawbacks, I believe its benefits are greater.
Many people work from home nowadays.
I work from home and I like it very much.

why.tr: B iki tarafı da kabul ediyor ve kararını veriyor (benefits are greater). A sadece soruyu tekrarlıyor, karar yok; C genel bilgi; D kişisel ve akademik değil.
why.ar: B يعترف بالجانبين ويعطي حكمًا واضحًا (benefits are greater). A يكرّر السؤال بلا حكم، وC معلومة عامة، وD شخصي وغير أكاديمي.
why.en: B accepts both sides and gives a clear answer; A has no position.

blocks.example: Although the plan is expensive, I believe its benefits are greater than its costs.

blocks.prompt: Why does the model answer discuss the disadvantages first?
options: Because disadvantages must always come first.
So that the essay ends with the side the writer thinks is stronger.
Because the question mentions disadvantages first.
To make the essay longer.

why.tr: Kural yok; ama yazar avantajların daha güçlü olduğunu düşündüğü için onları ikinci sıraya koyuyor. Böylece makale görüşüne doğru ilerliyor ve sonuç doğal olarak geliyor. C yanlış: soruda önce "advantages" geçiyor.
why.ar: لا توجد قاعدة ثابتة، لكن الكاتب يرى أن المزايا أقوى فيضعها ثانيًا، فيتجه المقال نحو رأيه وتأتي الخاتمة طبيعية. وC خطأ لأن السؤال يذكر المزايا أولًا.
why.en: Putting the stronger side second lets the essay build towards the writer's view.

blocks.example: I described the problems first and finished with the stronger arguments in favour.

blocks.prompt: Working from home has some disadvantages. ___ the other hand, the advantages are considerable. (one word)

why.tr: Sabit ifade: "On the other hand" = öte yandan (karşı tarafı tanıtır). "In the other hand" denmez. İlk tarafı "On the one hand" ile açabilirsin.
why.ar: التعبير الثابت On the other hand أي من ناحية أخرى، ولا نقول In the other hand. ويمكن أن تبدأ الجانب الأول بـ On the one hand.
why.en: The fixed phrase is "On the other hand".

blocks.example: City life is exciting. On the other hand, it can be very expensive.

blocks.prompt: Employees who rarely see colleagues may feel lonely. ___, the line between work and home life can become unclear.
options: In addition
However
As a result
For example

why.tr: İki cümle de dezavantaj; ikincisi yeni bir dezavantaj ekliyor. Ekleme için "In addition". "However" zıtlık, "As a result" sonuç bildirir; burada ikinci cümle birincinin sonucu değil.
why.ar: الجملتان عيبان، والثانية تضيف عيبًا جديدًا، فنستخدم In addition للإضافة. أما However فللتضاد، وAs a result للنتيجة، والجملة الثانية ليست نتيجة للأولى.
why.en: Both sentences are disadvantages: adding a point needs "In addition".

blocks.example: The hotel was expensive. In addition, the rooms were small.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Companies can benefit of smaller offices.”

why.tr: Fiil olarak "benefit from something" (bir şeyden yararlanmak). İsim olarak ise "the benefit of something": "the benefits of working from home". Fiil + from, isim + of.
why.ar: الفعل benefit from something أي يستفيد من. أما الاسم فـ the benefit of: the benefits of working from home. أي: فعل + from، واسم + of.
why.en: Verb: benefit from; noun: the benefit of.

blocks.example: Everyone benefits from a good night's sleep.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Many employees spend two hours a day to commute.”

why.tr: Kalıp: "spend + zaman/para + V-ing": spend two hours commuting. "spend time to do" yanlıştır.
why.ar: التركيب spend + وقت/مال + فعل بـ -ing: spend two hours commuting. ولا نقول spend time to do.
why.en: Spend + time + -ing: spend two hours commuting.

blocks.example: She spends an hour every evening reading.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence uses a formal, impersonal style suitable for Task 2?
options: I hate going to the office, it's so boring!
Lots of people think working at home is great.
Many employees find that they can concentrate better at home.
Working from home is awesome for everyone.

why.tr: C nesnel ve ölçülü: genel bir özne (many employees), abartı yok. A kişisel ve duygusal; B'de "lots of" ve "great" gündelik; D'de "awesome" argo ve "for everyone" aşırı genelleme.
why.ar: C موضوعية ومعتدلة: فاعل عام (many employees) بلا مبالغة. A شخصية وعاطفية، وفي B كلمتا lots of وgreat عاميتان، وD فيها awesome العامية وتعميم for everyone.
why.en: C is neutral and measured; the others are informal or overgeneralise.

blocks.example: Many students find that they learn better in small groups.

blocks.prompt: Which is the best final sentence for the conclusion?
options: So working from home is good and bad.
Because the savings in time, money and stress are so significant, the advantages clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
In the future, robots will do all office work.
There are many other topics to discuss about working.

why.tr: Sonuç, girişteki kararı yeni sözcüklerle tekrarlamalı ve soruyu doğrudan yanıtlamalı. B bunu yapıyor ve gerekçe veriyor. A karar vermiyor; C ve D sonuçta yeni ve ilgisiz fikirler getiriyor.
why.ar: يجب أن تعيد الخاتمة حكم المقدمة بكلمات جديدة وتجيب عن السؤال مباشرة، وهذا ما يفعله B مع ذكر السبب. A بلا حكم، وC وD تضيفان أفكارًا جديدة لا علاقة لها.
why.en: The conclusion restates the answer with a reason; C and D add new ideas.

blocks.example: Because the benefits are so significant, the advantages clearly outweigh the drawbacks.

units.title: Describing a Bar Chart
units.goal: Task 1 bar chart: compare the categories, find the biggest differences and group the data sensibly.

blocks.text: The task

The bar chart shows the average number of hours per week that people in three age groups in one country spent on four leisure activities in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. (The figures are practice data written for Bo-ok.)
The data
Hours per week, 2024 (practice data)
Social media: aged 16–24 — 18 · aged 25–44 — 10 · aged 45–64 — 5
Watching television: aged 16–24 — 8 · aged 25–44 — 12 · aged 45–64 — 17
Sport and exercise: aged 16–24 — 5 · aged 25–44 — 4 · aged 45–64 — 3
Reading books: aged 16–24 — 2 · aged 25–44 — 3 · aged 45–64 — 6
What the task asks

A bar chart often shows one point in time, so there may be no trend to describe. Instead, compare: which activity was most popular in each group, where the biggest differences were and what the patterns were across the ages. Write an overview of the main comparisons without detailed numbers. Then group the information, for example the activities that fell with age and those that rose with age, and support each point with figures. The year is in the past, so use past tenses, and do not explain why people behave this way.
A band-7 model answer
The bar chart compares how many hours a week people from three age groups in one country devoted to four leisure activities in 2024.

Overall, the youngest group spent most of their free time on social media, while the oldest group watched far more television than any other activity. Time spent on social media and exercise decreased with age, whereas television and reading became more popular among older people.

Social media was by far the main activity for 16- to 24-year-olds, at 18 hours a week, which was more than twice the time they spent watching television (8 hours). This figure fell to 10 hours for the 25–44 group and to just 5 hours for those aged 45–64. Exercise followed a similar but much smaller downward pattern, dropping slightly from 5 hours among the youngest to 3 hours among the oldest.

The opposite was true of television, which rose steadily across the age groups, from 8 hours to 12 and then to 17 hours a week, making it the most common activity for both older groups. Reading was the least popular activity overall, but people aged 45–64 read for 6 hours a week, three times as long as the youngest group.
Useful phrases

items.example: The bar chart compares the cost of three types of energy.
Older people devoted more time to reading.
The car was by far the main way to get to work.
Women read more than twice as many books as men.
The second film was three times as long as the first.
Sales in the north showed a similar pattern.
Coffee sales fell. The opposite was true of tea.
Cycling was the least popular way to travel.

blocks.text: Practice

blocks.prompt: Which is the best overview for this chart?
options: Young people spent 18 hours on social media and 8 hours watching television.
Overall, social media and exercise declined with age, while television and reading became more popular among older people.
Young people spend too much time on their phones.
Social media is bad for people's health.

why.tr: Overview sayısız genel resim verir: yaşla azalan ve yaşla artan etkinlikler. A ayrıntılı sayılar içeriyor (gövde paragrafı); C ve D görüş bildiriyor, Task 1'de görüş yazılmaz.
why.ar: الملخص العام يعطي الصورة الكبرى بلا أرقام: أنشطة تقلّ مع العمر وأخرى تزيد. A فيه أرقام تفصيلية مكانها الفقرات، وC وD رأي شخصي لا يُكتب في المهمة الأولى.
why.en: An overview gives the main patterns without numbers and without opinions.

blocks.example: Overall, younger people preferred online activities, while older people preferred traditional ones.

blocks.prompt: This chart shows one year only. Which kind of language is most important?
options: Language of comparison (more than, twice as long as, the least popular).
Language of change over time (rose sharply between 2010 and 2020).
Language of opinion (I think, in my view).
Language of cause (because, due to).

why.tr: Tek bir yıl olduğu için zaman içindeki değişim (trend) yok; görev kategorileri karşılaştırmak. Modelde "rose steadily across the age groups" ifadesi zaman değil, yaş grupları arasındaki farkı anlatıyor. Görüş ve neden Task 1'de yazılmaz.
why.ar: المخطط لسنة واحدة، فلا يوجد تغيّر عبر الزمن؛ المهمة هي المقارنة. وعبارة rose steadily across the age groups في النموذج تصف الفرق بين الفئات العمرية لا الزمن. والرأي والأسباب لا تُكتب في المهمة الأولى.
why.en: One year means no time trend: compare the categories.

blocks.example: Women spent twice as long as men on housework.

blocks.prompt: Young people spent 18 hours on social media, more than ___ the time they spent watching television (8 hours). (one word)

why.tr: 18, 8'in iki katından fazla (16'dan büyük): "more than twice". "two times" konuşmada duyulur ama yazıda "twice" tercih edilir. "double" burada yapıya uymaz.
why.ar: 18 أكثر من ضعف 8 (أكبر من 16): more than twice. قد تُسمع two times في الكلام، لكن twice أفضل في الكتابة، وdouble لا يناسب هذا التركيب.
why.en: 18 is more than 2 × 8 = 16: "more than twice".

blocks.example: The new bridge cost more than twice the original estimate.

blocks.prompt: People aged 45–64 read for 6 hours a week, three times as ___ as the youngest group. (one word)

why.tr: Kalıp: "three times as long as" (süre için). 6 = 3 × 2. "three times longer than" de kullanılır, ama "as … as" yapısında "as" iki kez gelir.
why.ar: التركيب three times as long as للمدة، و6 = 3 × 2. ويُستخدم أيضًا three times longer than، لكن في تركيب as … as تتكرر as مرتين.
why.en: "Three times as long as" (6 = 3 × 2).

blocks.example: The journey by bus takes three times as long as by train.

blocks.prompt: Social media fell with age. ___ was true of television, which rose across the age groups.
options: The opposite
The same
A similar pattern
The result

why.tr: Sosyal medya yaşla azalıyor, televizyon artıyor: ters yönler. "The opposite was true of …" bu zıtlığı gösterir. B ve C aynı yönü anlatırdı.
why.ar: وسائل التواصل تقلّ مع العمر والتلفزيون يزيد، أي اتجاهان متعاكسان، فنقول The opposite was true of. أما B وC فتعنيان الاتجاه نفسه.
why.en: Opposite directions: "The opposite was true of television".

blocks.example: Imports fell. The opposite was true of exports, which rose.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “Exercise was the less popular activity for all groups except the youngest.”

why.tr: Üç ya da daha fazla şey karşılaştırılıyorsa üstünlük derecesi: "the least popular". "less" iki şeyi karşılaştırır: less popular than.
why.ar: عند المقارنة بين ثلاثة أشياء أو أكثر نستخدم صيغة التفضيل: the least popular. أما less فلمقارنة شيئين: less popular than.
why.en: With three or more items: the least popular. "Less" compares two.

blocks.example: Of all the options, the bus was the least expensive.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is accurate according to the data?
options: People aged 25–44 spent more time on social media than on television.
Television was the most common activity for both of the older groups.
The youngest group read more than the oldest group.
Exercise time rose with age.

why.tr: 25–44: TV 12 > sosyal medya 10; 45–64: TV 17 en yüksek. Yani B doğru. A: 10 < 12. C: 2 < 6. D: egzersiz 5 → 4 → 3 azalıyor. Task 1'de her cümleyi verilerle kontrol et.
why.ar: الفئة 25–44: التلفزيون 12 أكبر من التواصل 10، والفئة 45–64: التلفزيون 17 هو الأعلى، لذا B صحيح. A: 10 أقل من 12، وC: 2 أقل من 6، وD: الرياضة تقلّ 5 ← 4 ← 3.
why.en: TV led for 25–44 (12 vs 10) and 45–64 (17). The others contradict the figures.

blocks.example: Walking was the most common way to travel for both groups.

blocks.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word. “The time spent on exercise drop slightly from 5 hours to 3 hours.”

why.tr: Veri 2024'e, yani geçmişe ait: geçmiş zaman gerekir. "drop" → "dropped" (sessiz harf iki kez yazılır). Ayrıca tekil özneyle geniş zamanda bile "drops" olurdu.
why.ar: البيانات لعام 2024، أي في الماضي، فنستخدم الماضي: drop ← dropped (بمضاعفة الحرف). وحتى في المضارع مع فاعل مفرد يجب أن تكون drops.
why.en: The data is from the past: dropped (double p).

blocks.example: Attendance dropped slightly in the second year.

blocks.prompt: How does the model answer organise its two body paragraphs?
options: One paragraph for each age group.
Activities that fell with age, then activities that rose with age.
The largest numbers first, then the smallest numbers.
Advantages first, then disadvantages.

why.tr: Birinci gövde paragrafı sosyal medya ve egzersizi (yaşla azalan), ikincisi televizyon ve okumayı (yaşla artan) anlatıyor. Benzer örüntüleri gruplamak, her çubuğu tek tek anlatmaktan daha iyi bir "coherence" sağlar.
why.ar: تتناول الفقرة الأولى التواصل الاجتماعي والرياضة (يقلّان مع العمر)، والثانية التلفزيون والقراءة (يزيدان). تجميع الأنماط المتشابهة أفضل للترابط من وصف كل عمود وحده.
why.en: Grouping by pattern (falling, then rising) is clearer than describing bar by bar.

blocks.example: First I described the costs that went up, then the ones that went down.
